items.title: Midland County Judge Terry Johnson indicted; Chapter 87 removal pending
items.summary: Johnson surrendered Aug. 19 after indictment on two third-degree felonies. Chapter 87 removal petition filed Aug. 6 (Cause DCV-26-01527). Judge R. Shane Seaton assigned. No public SCJC sanction located as of 22 Aug.

items.title: Outside prosecutor assigned in Johnson removal suit
items.summary: Judge Ben Woodward assigned Allison Palmer, 51st Judicial District Attorney, to represent the State in the Johnson removal suit.

items.title: Angelina County JP Donald Puckett — Rangers affidavit on training substitution
items.summary: Affidavit reporting: Puckett required an employee to complete Texas Justice Court Training Center coursework in his place. No SCJC public sanction located in the current window.

items.title: Angelina County JP Donald Puckett convicted of abuse of official capacity
items.summary: Texas Rangers arrested Precinct 2 JP Puckett on or about Aug. 14. Nolo contendere plea the same day before Judge Todd Kassaw. Convicted and fined $2,290.

items.title: 2026 interim charges summary — divorce and custody streamlining noted
items.summary: Interim-charge summary published Aug. 17. Adjacent item: Senate State Affairs charge on streamlining divorce and child-custody proceedings.

items.title: OCA digital court reporting study — report due not later than 1 Oct 2026
items.summary: 89th Legislature directed OCA to study digital court reporting. No new public interim findings in the 17–22 Aug scans.
